description.en: Northern Palestine: 'including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights' (Amitai 2017).
description.ar: شمال فلسطين: 'including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights' [بما في ذلك مناطق في جنوب لبنان وهضبة الجولان اليوم] (عميتاي 2017).
description.he: צפון פלשתינה: “including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights” [כולל אזורים בדרום לבנון של ימינו וברמת הגולן] (עמיתי 2017).

sources.quote: In the north was the niyābah or mamlakah – both of which can be translated as “province” in this context – of Ṣafad, including areas in modern-day southern Lebanon and the Golan Heights.

notes.en: Whether the Acre plain (after 1291) and all of Lower Galilee belonged to Safad was not verified.
notes.ar: لم يُتحقق مما إذا كان سهل عكا (بعد 1291) والجليل الأدنى كله تابعًا لصفد.
notes.he: לא אומת אם מישור עכו (אחרי 1291) וכל הגליל התחתון השתייכו לצפת.
